## Summary

Build an approved-only local ingestion plane with a source registry, real metadata extraction, reconciled and resumable file synchronization, explicit conversation-derived ingestion, a drop-folder collector, and language-aware full-text search.

## Scope

- Register and authorize ingestible local sources.
- Reconcile Git repositories and directories, including renames and deletes.
- Support resumable synchronization and approved collectors.
- Improve lexical retrieval with language-aware FTS.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Only explicitly registered sources can be ingested.
- [ ] Git and directory sync handles additions, renames, deletes, interruption, and resume without duplicates.
- [ ] Drop-folder and distilled conversation ingestion use real metadata extraction.
- [ ] Language-aware FTS passes the live no-regression gate.

## Non-goals

- Raw transcript dumping.
- Unbounded web crawling.
- Cross-namespace ingestion.

## Standing constraints

- Exact namespace and session-scope isolation remains a security boundary.
- Prompt placement stays client/runtime-owned; no implicit MCP `_meta` injection.
- Observability remains content-free.
- Dream planning remains dry-run-safe unless a separately authorized mutating wrapper is used.
